titulo: Sauce Gardner, who aligned as the right outside cornerback on 58 snaps (95%) allowed four receptions for 117 yards and a touchdown on five targets in coverage against the Commanders in Week 4, the most yards allowed in a game by Gardner in his career.
detalle: The Colts other outside cornerback, Charvarius Ward who aligned at left cornerback for 57 snaps, allowed two receptions for 13 yards on seven targets in coverage with three passes defensed.

titulo: The Falcons generated pressure on 15 of the Ravens' 38 dropbacks (39.5%) in Week 5.
detalle: On the Ravens' first nine drives, Atlanta produced a 53.8% pressure rate; on the final two drives, they generated just 1 pressure on 12 dropbacks (8.3%), allowing touchdowns on both drives. The Falcons blitzed on 10 of 13 dropbacks in the first five drives after blitzing on just 20.2% of dropbacks entering Week 5, then blitzed at a 36.0% rate the rest of the game. 11 different Falcons generated pressure, led by Brandon Dorlus with four. This was the fourth time in five games this season Atlanta has had 10 or more players record pressure.

titulo: Daniel Jones completed 24 of his 44 pass attempts for 267 yards in Week 5 against the Steelers.
detalle: Much of his success came on passes thrown under 10 air yards, where he completed 20 of 26 attempts for 154 yards, posting a +5.7% completion percentage over expected. When he pushed the ball downfield (10+ air yards), Jones completed just four of 17 attempts for 113 yards (-18.7% CPOE).

titulo: Trey Hendrickson finished with 8 pressures and a sack on 26 pass rush matchups against Browns rookie left tackle Spencer Fano.
detalle: Hendrickson, who now ranks among the top 10 pass rushers in pressures this season (25), currently has a 22.7% pressure rate, the highest rate among pass rushers with at least 25 pressures this season.

titulo: Chuba Hubbard rushed for 120 yards and a touchdown on 28 carries against the Eagles on Sunday, gaining 133 yards after contact, the most in a game in his career and the third-most of any player this season.
detalle: Hubbard was hit behind the line of scrimmage on 17 of his carries but gained 56 yards on those runs.

titulo: Bobby Okereke generated five pressures on 15 pass rushes (33.3%) against the Eagles in Week 6, all within 2.5 seconds of the snap, including a sack.
detalle: His five quick pressures were tied for third among inside linebackers in a game since 2018 and his most in a game in his career.

titulo: Justin Herbert completed 10 of his 20 quick pass attempts (under 2.5 seconds) for 26 yards against the Chiefs in Week 6, averaging 1.3 yards per attempt, the fifth-fewest mark in any game since 2016 (min. 10 attempts).
detalle: On pass attempts over 2.5 seconds, Herbert completed 12 of his 17 attempts for 178 yards and his only interception. Herbert completed 5 of 8 downfield attempts for a season-high 113 passing yards in the second half, after not completing a downfield attempt in the first half.

titulo: Kirk Cousins completed 23 of his 41 pass attempts for 313 yards, two touchdowns and an interception in Week 6 against the Bills.
detalle: Cousins completed 18 of 26 attempts for 238 yards, with both touchdowns and his lone interception against zone coverage (+3.5% CPOE), compared to 5 of 15 for 75 yards against man coverage (-5.7% CPOE).

titulo: Christian Gonzalez matched up against Garrett Wilson on 17 routes in Week 6, 12 of them in man coverage, and allowed two receptions for 20 yards on two targets.
detalle: That's the fewest targets, receptions and yards Gonzalez has allowed to Wilson in any game where the two matched up more than five times. Gonzalez played all 60 defensive snaps in his first game back after missing two games. In his return, New England played man coverage on 36.4% of coverage snaps, compared to 29.3% in Weeks 4 and 5 without him, and allowed 3.3 yards per play in man, compared to 7.2 in those two games.

titulo: Chase Young generated four pressures (21.1% pressure rate) and 1.5 extended sacks (over 4 seconds) against Andrew Thomas in Week 6.
detalle: Thomas allowed a team-high five pressures before exiting with an injury, and has now allowed 18 pressures in his last three games after allowing nine in his first three games.

titulo: Treylon Burks caught 4 of his 6 targets for 66 yards against the Commanders, recording a team high 2.4 yards per route run (minimum 5 routes).
detalle: This is his most yards in a game since Week 2 of the 2023 season (Chargers, 76). His 59 completed air yards were the most on the team, 20 air yards more than second-place Antonio Williams (39).

titulo: Michael Penix Jr. faced pressure on just six of 35 dropbacks in Week 7 against the 49ers (17.1%), resulting in the second-lowest pressure rate in a game of his career.
detalle: Each of the Falcons' five starting offensive lineman logged 34 pass-blocking snaps without allowing a pressure, as backup running back Khalil Herbert was the only Falcons pass-blocker to allow a pressure. Penix faced five unblocked pressures after facing 10 such pressures over each of his first four games played dating back to Week 3. He was efficient when kept clean, completing 22 of 28 passes for 191 yards and three touchdowns, tied for his most such touchdowns in a game of his career.

titulo: The Falcons forced a season-high four turnovers in their Week 7 win over the 49ers, their first multi-turnover game of the season.
detalle: The Falcons gained +41.8% win probability on these four turnovers, including two interceptions, both of which occurred when the Falcons sent four or fewer rushers. Despite blitzing on just 16.7% of Purdy's dropbacks (the unit's lowest rate in a game this season), the Falcons pressured Purdy at a 57.0% rate when blitzing, their second-highest pressure rate when blitzing this season.

titulo: Zay Flowers set a career high with 103 yards after the catch in Week 7 against the Bengals, including +63 YAC over expected (also a career high).
detalle: Flowers' final stat line consisted of 8 receptions for 137 yards and a touchdown on 11 targets, with six of his receptions, seven of his targets, 120 of his yards, and the touchdown coming in the first half. Flowers totaled just 2 receptions for 17 yards on 4 targets in the second half.

titulo: The Ravens win probability peaked at 87.5% with 1:37 left in the first half, before the Bengals scored 35 unanswered points to win 35-13.
detalle: This marks the Ravens 10th loss over the last three seasons where their win probability reached at least 80%, two more than the next closest team.

titulo: Derrick Henry had just four carries for 13 yards in the second half of the Ravens' loss to the Bengals in Week 7, finishing the game with 17 carries for 45 yards and a 17.6% success rate (3 successful runs).
detalle: This marks the second consecutive week Henry has posted a rushing success rate below 25% (23.5% in Week 6 vs CLE). Henry had just one such game last season (14.3% in Week 12 vs NYJ).

titulo: Javonte Williams rushed for a career-high 155 rushing yards in the Cowboys’ Week 7 win over the Eagles.
detalle: Williams’ 13 successful runs is a career high with four of these carries gaining at least 10 yards, tied for the second most of his career. Williams forced eight missed tackles, tied for the most of his career.

titulo: Danielle Hunter generated five pressures, two quick pressures, and a sack in Week 7.
detalle: Hunter averaged a time to pressure of 2.56 seconds, his quickest in a game since 2023 (min. 5 pressures).

titulo: Malik Willis completed 7 of 9 passes under pressure for a career-high 138 yards and a touchdown in the Dolphins' first win in Week 7, adding three scramble runs for 20 yards and another score against pressure.
detalle: Willis finished 11-for-16 for 184 yards and two touchdowns from inside the pocket (+12.2 EPA). He entered the game with -29.7 EPA and one touchdown from the pocket in his first five games this season.

titulo: The Vikings blitzed on 85.2% of Daniel Jones' dropbacks against the Colts in Week 7, the highest blitz rate by any defense in a game in the Next Gen Stats era (since 2016).
detalle: Minnesota generated pressure on 60.9% of those blitzes, with all four its sacks coming when blitzing.

titulo: Dallas Turner generated six pressures on 18 pass rushes against the Colts on Sunday, including three on five pass rushes against Bernhard Raimann.
detalle: Turner has generated 39 pressures this season, the second-most in the NFL behind Will Anderson Jr. (41) on one less game played.

titulo: Drake Maye was pressured on 15 of his 35 dropbacks (42.9%) in the Patriots’ Week 7 loss to the Bears but still completed 24-of-31 passes for 321 yards, two touchdowns, and an interception.
detalle: Maye was nearly perfect against pressure, completing 11-of-12 attempts for 151 yards and a touchdown. Maye's 91.7% completion percentage under pressure is tied for the highest completion percentage in a game this season (Geno Smith, Week 3 vs Lions).

titulo: Tyler Shough completed 30 of 38 passes for 278 yards, one touchdown and one interception against the Steelers in Week 7.
detalle: Shough produced a successful play on 59.5% of his dropbacks, the highest rate in a game in his career.

titulo: The Saints gained 11 yards on 14 designed runs against the Steelers on Sunday (0.8 yards per carry), the fewest yards per designed run by any team in a game this season.
detalle: It was also the fewest yards per designed run the Steelers have allowed in a game since Week 1 of 2020.

titulo: After playing just six snaps and not touching the ball once in Week 6, Cam Skattebo led the Giants backfield with 36 snaps, 17 carries, and 124 rushing yards.
detalle: Skattebo tied his season high with six missed tackles and generated four explosive carries after recording just five explosives through Week 6. The Texans defense allowed a 50.0% rushing success rate and missed 11 tackles in run defense, both season highs.

titulo: Deonte Banks allowed just 1 reception for 4 yards across 14 matchups against Nico Collins, 10 of which he played in man coverage.
detalle: All four of his targets against Collins were in a tight window, his second-most in a single matchup in his career.

titulo: Geno Smith completed 6 of 7 passes for 174 yards and two touchdowns against man coverage in Week 7 against the Dolphins, his most yardage in a single game since at least 2018.
detalle: Smith averaged 24.9 yards per attempt against man, the third-most by any quarterback in a game in that span (min. such 5 attempts), compared to just 4.9 against zone; he also threw his only interception against zone coverage. Smith was pressured on two of nine dropbacks (22.2%) against man compared to 13 of 24 (54.2%) against zone.

titulo: Riq Woolen was targeted on a season high 25.0% of his coverage snaps (7 of 28) against the Cowboys; on his seven targets he allowed five receptions (tied for season high) for 111 yards (career high).
detalle: Despite recording two passes defensed on three tight window targets (<1 yard of separation), he allowed an average of 5.4 yards of separation on his five receptions allowed.

titulo: Quinyon Mitchell was targeted on 33.3% of his coverage snaps in his Week 7 battle against the Cowboys, a season high and the second highest rate of his career (43.5%, 2024 Week 13 vs Cowboys).
detalle: On his eight targets, he allowed just three receptions for 24 yards; his 37.5% completion rate allowed and 3.0 yards per target are both season lows. In seven matchups against CeeDee Lamb, Mitchell was targeted four times, allowing just one reception for 5 yards, forcing one tight window target (<1 yard of separation).

titulo: Jaylen Warren gained 137 yards from scrimmage (101 rushing, 36 receiving) in the Steelers' Week 7 win over the Saints.
detalle: He gained 71 of his rushing yards after contact, his second-most in a game this season, and forced five missed tackles. Warren finished with 46 yards after the catch, increasing his league-leading YAC total to 360 this season.

titulo: Aaron Rodgers completed 19 of 30 passes for 212 yards, one touchdown and no interceptions against the Saints in Week 7.
detalle: Rodgers' 46 air yard completion to DK Metcalf in the second quarter was his longest completion by air yards since Week 6 of 2024. It was also Metcalf's longest reception by air yards since Week 3 of 2020.

titulo: Sam Darnold completed 20 of his 28 pass attempts for 257 yards, a touchdown and an interception in Week 7 against the Chiefs.
detalle: Darnold posted a 2.45-second average time to throw, his third-quickest in a game in his career, while facing pressure on just 26.7% of his dropbacks, his lowest rate in a game this season. Darnold was nearly perfect when getting the ball out quickly (under 2.5 seconds), completing 13 of 14 such attempts for 149 yards and a touchdown. When holding the ball longer than 2.5 seconds, he completed seven of 13 passes for 108 yards with an interception.

titulo: Nick Emmanwori allowed just two receptions for 26 yards on seven targets in coverage, forcing the most incompletions in coverage (5) in a game in his career.
detalle: Emmanwori generated two pressures on 10 pass rushes, including a second-quarter pressure that forced a Patrick Mahomes interception. Entering Week 7 Monday Night Football, he leads all defensive backs with 12 pressures this season.

titulo: The Seahawks held the Chiefs to three points in their Week 7 win, playing nickel or dime defense on all 50 plays.
detalle: This was just the third game of the season in which a defense did not play base or heavy personnel a single time (CLE Week 2, Week 3). Seattle limited the Chiefs to just 213 yards (4.3 per play) after Kansas City entered Week 7 leading the NFL with 7.3 yards per play against 5+ defensive backs.

titulo: George Kittle totaled team-highs in targets (10), receptions (8), and receiving yards (88) across 34 routes run in Week 7 against the Falcons, including 47 yards after the catch.
detalle: Despite the 49ers having just a 2.7% chance to win the game prior to the play, Kittle gained 22 yards before fumbling with 57 seconds remaining in the fourth quarter, sealing the game for the Falcons. Entering the Sunday afternoon slate of Week 7, Kittle leads all tight ends league-wide with 425 receiving yards and 228 yards after the catch. Coming off a torn Achilles suffered last season, Kittle (76.7%) is the only 49ers skill player (RB, WR & TE) to have played on more than three-quarters of his team's offensive snaps this season.

titulo: Gardner Minshew completed 17 of 23 passes for 188 yards and three touchdowns in the Cardinals' overtime victory over the Cowboys, with all three touchdowns coming in the fourth quarter.
detalle: Minshew first took the field with Arizona holding just a 4.0% win probability and 1:35 remaining in the third quarter. He was sacked once and pressured on just eight of 24 dropbacks (33.3% pressure rate), compared to Jacoby Brissett, who was sacked four times and pressured on 16 of 29 dropbacks before exiting (55.2% pressure rate). Minshew threw all three of his touchdowns from a clean pocket, including the game-tying 13-yard touchdown pass to Michael Wilson before the end of regulation.

titulo: Jacoby Brissett was sacked three times and completed just eight of 20 passes for 68 yards and an interception when facing four or fewer rushers in Week 8 against the Cowboys, resulting in his lowest completion percentage when facing four or fewer rushers in a game during his tenure in Arizona (40.0%).
detalle: Brissett totaled just 17 fewer passing yards (51) across 17 fewer passes when blitzed (3). Overall, Brissett was sacked four times and pressured on 16 of 29 dropbacks (55.2%), his highest pressure rate faced in a game this season.

titulo: Tyler Allgeier carried the ball 11 times for 147 yards and a touchdown in Week 8 against the Cowboys, including three explosive gains of 10 or more yards, after totaling just two explosive gains across 61 carries over the first seven weeks of the season.
detalle: Allgeier recorded a 63-yard touchdown run on Arizona's final play from scrimmage in the third quarter before opening the Cardinals' next drive with a 52-yard scamper. He gained +96 rushing yards over expected, the most by a Cardinals rusher in a game since at least 2018. Additionally, Allgeier finished as the Cardinals' third-leading receiver, catching all five targets for 44 yards and a touchdown.

titulo: Bryce Young was pressured on 48.9% of his dropbacks against the Packers in Week 8.
detalle: When under pressure, he completed 7-of-17 passes for 41 yards with no touchdowns, one interception and six sacks. Over the last two weeks, Young has been pressured on 50.0% of dropbacks and averaged 3.2 yards per attempt when pressured. Through Weeks 1-6, he was pressured on 39.4% of dropbacks and averaged 6.2 yards per attempt under pressure. Three Packers generated five or more pressures, led by Brenton Cox (6 pressures on 20 pass rushes, 30.0%), with Dani Dennis-Sutton (5 on 18, 27.8%) and Lukas Van Ness (5 on 23, 21.7%) close behind.

titulo: In their Week 8 win over the Seahawks, the Bears defense allowed just one third-down conversion on 11 attempts, a 9.1% conversion rate that ranks fifth-lowest by a team this season.
detalle: The Bears have allowed the lowest third down conversion rate this season (23.8%) as they've held opposing offenses to the most yards to gain on third down (8.2). They generated just one blitz on 10 drop backs (10.0%), their lowest third-down blitz rate under Dennis Allen.

titulo: Joe Burrow completed 38 of 48 passes for 462 yards against the Titans in Week 8, tying his career high with five touchdowns while throwing three interceptions.
detalle: Burrow completed 16 of 18 passes targeting out breaking routes for 154 yards and one touchdown, his most completions and yards throwing to out breaking routes this season. Burrow was also effective when the Titans blitzed (30.2%, 3rd-highest in a game by Titans this season) completing 11 of 13 attempts for 142 yards, three touchdowns, and an interception, tied for his most touchdowns against the blitz in a game in his career.

titulo: Harold Fannin recorded 81 of his 154 receiving yards after the catch in Week 8 against the Steelers, generating +21 YAC over expected.
detalle: Fannin now leads all tight ends in YAC (237) and YACOE (+67) entering the afternoon slate.

titulo: Dak Prescott completed 7 of his 11 pass attempts for 93 yards and one touchdown against the blitz in their Week 8 loss against the Cardinals.
detalle: Against the blitz, Prescott averaged 11.0 air yards per attempt, the second time this season he has averaged over 10 air yards, despite 27.3% of his passes traveling at or behind the line of scrimmage. However, he was sacked three times when blitzed, his first multi-sack game against the blitz all season.

titulo: Garett Bolles did not allow a pressure on 35 pass blocks in Week 8, the third time this season he has held his opposition without pressure.
detalle: Bolles faced George Karlaftis on 14 matchups, including 13 one-on-ones. Bolles is the only left tackle who has not allowed pressure in three different games this season.

titulo: Bo Nix completed 7 of 10 passes for 110 yards and two touchdowns in the Broncos' Week 8 win, including 5 of 7 for 67 yards and both scores on designed rollouts.
detalle: He is one of just three passers with 60+ passing yards and two touchdowns on designed rollouts in a game this season. Nix was most effective when the Chiefs played man coverage, completing 5 of 6 passes for 75 yards and a touchdown against man after entering the week with the lowest completion percentage in the NFL (41.3%) against man.

titulo: Jahmyr Gibbs forced 12 missed tackles across 25 touches in the Lions' Week 8 win over the Vikings.
detalle: Gibbs now has four games this season with double-digit missed tackles forced, the most by any player in the NFL. His 99 yards after missed tackles forced is a career high and the fourth most by any player this season. Gibbs rushed for 110 of his 153 yards on zone carries, his third-most in a single game of his career, with his career high coming in a Week 18, 2024 matchup against the Vikings (143 yards).

titulo: The Vikings blitzed on 26 of 29 dropbacks (89.7%) in their Week 8 loss against the Lions, the highest blitz rate by a team since at least 2018, breaking the previous record held by the Vikings set last week against the Colts (85.2%).
detalle: When blitzed, Jared Goff completed 17 passes, tied for the most against the blitz in a game this season, for 130 yards, a touchdown, and an interception. Goff was sacked a season-high three times on six pressures when blitzed.

titulo: Matthew Golden caught 7 of his 13 targets for 79 yards in a Week 8 win against the Panthers; all of Golden's receptions came when he had at least 3.0 yards of separation from his nearest defender.
detalle: His 36.1% target rate was the highest in a game in his career. He was targeted five times on deep passes (20+ air yards), however, only caught one of them, which resulted in his lone touchdown for the game.

titulo: Bhayshul Tuten rushed 16 times for 104 yards and a touchdown in Week 8 against the Colts, his most rushing yards in a game in his career.
detalle: A third of those carries came on outside zone, where he gained 56 yards and scored his rushing touchdown. He made a similar impact on limited work as a receiver, catching both of his targets for 55 yards and a touchdown on just three routes. Across his 18 touches, Tuten forced seven missed tackles and generated 69 yards after missed tackles, also a single-game career high.

titulo: The Jaguars' defense generated a 43.2% pressure rate in Week 8 against the Colts, recording four sacks and forcing two turnovers as a result of pressure.
detalle: Those two takeaways brought their total to seven turnovers caused by pressure this season, tied with the Vikings for the most in the NFL entering Sunday's late window. That pressure came from across the defense, as eight Jaguars defenders generated multiple pressures in the game.

titulo: Blake Corum carried the ball 11 times for 73 yards and one touchdown in a Week 8 win against the Chargers, touching the ball on 11 of his 17 snaps.
detalle: He averaged 5.8 yards after contact per carry (6.6 overall), his most this season and the second-highest average of his career (min. 5 carries). Nine of his 11 carries came on man-blocking runs, where he tallied 65 yards and his lone touchdown. He generated a season-high 23 yards after forcing missed tackles.

titulo: Justin Herbert completed a season-high 75.0% of his passes against the Rams in Week 8, completing 5 of his 6 downfield (10+ air yards) pass attempts for 135 yards.
detalle: Herbert completed all five of his downfield pass attempts in the first half, but on his lone downfield attempt in the second half it resulted in an interception. Targeting receivers downfield on just 6 of 32 pass attempts, Herbert finished the game with a season-low 18.8% downfield pass rate.

titulo: Justin Herbert was pressured on 17 of his 37 dropbacks (45.9%) against the Rams, completing over 70.0% of his passes under pressure for the first time this season.
detalle: Herbert completed 10 of his 14 pass attempts under pressure for 156 yards; he finished the game with more yards under pressure than from a clean pocket (101), with both of Herbert's interceptions coming from clean pockets.

titulo: Brock Bowers caught 7 of 10 targets for 92 yards and two touchdowns in the Raiders' Week 8 win, recording six of his receptions aligned as an outside receiver.
detalle: Bowers' six receptions lined up outside tied his career high from Week 3 this season and tied for the most by any tight end since at least 2016. No Raiders wide receiver has caught six passes lined up outside in a game this season.

titulo: Kirk Cousins faced man coverage on 63.0% of his dropbacks in the Raiders' Week 8 win over the Jets, the highest rate he has faced in a game since 2022, completing 11 of 16 passes against man for 131 yards and three touchdowns.
detalle: Cousins was most effective when targeting in-breaking routes, completing 15 of 17 such passes for 163 yards and two scores. He is the only quarterback in a game this season with 15 or more completions and two or more touchdowns on in-breakers.

titulo: Chop Robinson totaled eight pressures on 17 pass rushes against the Patriots in Week 8 (47.1%), the second-highest pressure rate of any NFL defender this season (min. 10 pass rushes).
detalle: Robinson recorded a team-high two sacks on these pressures, his highest pressure-to-sack rate (25.0%) this season. Robinson generated five of his pressures and a sack across eight matchups against Morgan Moses, with an additional pressure each against Will Campbell and Walter Rouse.

titulo: Malik Willis completed 21 of 32 passes for 211 yards with two touchdowns and one interception against the Patriots in Week 8.
detalle: Willis averaged 2.70 seconds to throw, his second-fastest in a game this season, after entering Week 8 with the league's second-longest average time to throw (3.13 seconds). Getting the ball out quickly worked, as Willis completed 10 of 11 passes for 65 yards and a touchdown when throwing in under 2.5 seconds. When he held the ball longer than 2.5 seconds, he completed 11 of 21 for 146 yards, a touchdown and an interception.

titulo: Kyler Murray threw for 210 yards, two touchdowns and one interception in the Vikings' Week 8 loss against the Lions.
detalle: Murray averaged 11.2 air yards per attempt, his second-highest mark in a game, trailing only a Week 3, 2024 matchup against the Lions (11.6). Murray targeted downfield (10+ air yards) on 44.8% of his attempts, his second-highest rate as a Viking. On downfield attempts, Murray threw for a season-high 115 yards despite only completing 4-of-13 attempts (30.8%), his lowest downfield completion rate in a game since 2023 (min. 10 downfield attempts).

titulo: Drake Maye completed 16 of 20 passes for 199 yards and two touchdowns against the Dolphins in Week 8.
detalle: Maye was perfect on throws of more than 10 air yards, completing all five attempts for 149 yards and both of his touchdowns. Since Week 4, Maye has thrown six deep (20+ air yards) touchdown passes without an interception, the most deep touchdowns in the NFL over that span.

titulo: Braelon Allen rushed 21 times for a career-high 147 yards and a touchdown in the Jets' Week 8 win, gaining 84 yards before contact.
detalle: Allen's yards before contact were the fifth-most by any running back this season and the most by a Jet since Week 5 of 2023. Allen racked up 62 rushing yards between the tackles, the most by a Jet this season, and 85 outside the tackles, the 2nd-most behind only his own performance last week (91 rushing yards outside tackles).

titulo: Adonai Mitchell caught 6 downfield passes (10+ air yards) for 135 yards and a touchdown, tied for the most downfield receiving yards by a Jet in the Next Gen Stats era (since 2016).
detalle: Mitchell was targeted on 7 of his 11 matchups against Eric Stokes, catching five passes for 73 yards and a touchdown in the matchup.

titulo: Jaylen Warren totaled 143 rushing yards and a touchdown on 17 carries in the Steelers' Week 8 win over the Browns, generating +80 rushing yards over expected, the third-most RYOE he's totaled in his career.
detalle: Warren now has +222 RYOE this season, second-most in the NFL behind only Kenneth Walker III (+263). Warren found most of his success on rushes to the right, with 115 of his yards coming on 12 such carries, including the touchdown and three explosive runs.

titulo: Alex Highsmith generated 6 pressures across 21 matchups (20 1-on-1) with Spencer Fano in Week 8, including two quick pressures under 2.5 seconds, and 0.5 sacks.
detalle: Highsmith also drew three holding calls, two of which were declined. Fano also allowed four pressures in 13 matchups with Nick Herbig, including one quick pressure and one sack.

titulo: Bucky Irving recorded 170 yards and a touchdown on 27 carries against the Falcons in Week 8, generating all 170 yards after contact, the third-most in a single game this season.
detalle: Kenny Gainwell is one of two running backs with more such yards after gaining 177 yards after contact in their week 8 matchup. Irving forced 8 missed tackles against the Falcons and gained 44 yards after those missed tackles, both his second most in a game this season.

titulo: Jacob Parrish did not allow a reception on either of his 2 targets when matched up against Drake London (7 matchups).
detalle: Parrish was responsible for Michael Penix Jr.'s third interception in the second quarter. Parrish also recorded 7 total tackles (T-most), which included three stops and two run stuffs and zero missed tackles.

titulo: Joshua Williams struggled in coverage against Bengals' pass catchers, allowing nine receptions for 133 yards and two touchdowns on 10 targets.
detalle: Williams allowed all six of his targets against Tee Higgins to be completed for 85 yards and a touchdown, and three of four targets for 48 yards and a touchdown against Ja'Marr Chase.

titulo: Jacob Martin generated six pressures and three sacks against the Bengals in Week 8, tied for the most pressures and most sacks by Martin in a game this season.
detalle: Martin matched up against Orlando Brown on 24 pass rushes, generating four pressures (16.7% pressure rate) and three sacks (12.5% sack rate).

titulo: Amani Hooker picked off Joe Burrow three times in Week 8, which included -15.3 expected points added across five targets in coverage, the second-most coverage EPA by a player in a game this season.
detalle: Hooker allowed only 12 yards in coverage on the day.

titulo: Cam Ward 26 of 40 passes for a career high 304 yards with two touchdowns against the Bengals in Week 8.
detalle: The Bengals used man coverage on 44.7% of their coverage snaps, their highest rate of man coverage in a game this season. Ward completed 11 of 17 passes for 158 yards and two touchdowns against man coverage, his more completions, yards, and touchdowns against man coverage in a game in his career.

titulo: Jayden Daniels completed 16 of his 29 pass attempts for 217 yards and a touchdown in the Commanders' Week 8 win against the Eagles.
detalle: More than two-thirds of that yardage came against man coverage, where he completed eight of 13 passes for a career-high 148 yards and a touchdown. Daniels was successful generating chunk plays, completing all three of his deep attempts (20+ air yards) for 104 yards, his most in a game since Week 8 of 2024 against the Bears. He added another 23 yards with his legs on two scrambles.

titulo: The Commanders generated pressure on 46.5% of dropbacks against the Eagles in Week 8, a season-high mark.
detalle: They generated 10 pressures and a sack on 12 blitzes (83.3%), the second-highest pressure rate by any defense in a game this season (min. 5 blitzes). Washington forced a season-high seven quick pressures (under 2.5 seconds) on their blitzes. While they produced just a 32.3% pressure rate when not blitzing, they did record four sacks rushing four or fewer.

titulo: K'Lavon Chaisson generated a season-high seven pressures and a sack on 28 pass rushes in Week 8 against the Eagles, his second-most pressures in a game in his career.
detalle: Much of that work came against Markel Bell, as Chaisson recorded three pressures and his lone sack across 18 matchups, including two quick pressures (under 2.5 seconds).

titulo: Gardner Minshew struggled when the Seahawks generated pressure in Week 9, completing just 2 of 6 passes under pressure for 12 yards and taking three sacks.
detalle: Minshew completed 19 of 24 passes for 154 yards when kept clean. The Seahawks played man coverage at their highest rate of the season (39.4%) after having done so at the second-lowest rate in the NFL (13.0%) entering the game, and they held Minshew to six completions on 12 attempts for 46 yards and a sack when playing man.

titulo: Michael Penix Jr. completed 20 of 31 passes for 162 yards with a touchdown and an interception against the Bengals.
detalle: Penix went 19 of 23 for 165 yards and a touchdown when kept clean, but 1 of 8 for -3 yards and an interception when pressured, the fewest yards when pressured by any quarterback in a game since 2018 (min. 7 pressured attempts).

titulo: Josh Allen was blitzed on 68.6% of his dropbacks against the Vikings, the highest blitz rate he has faced in his career.
detalle: Allen was pressured on 10 of 24 dropbacks when blitzed (41.7%), completing 12 of 20 passes for 108 yards and an interception while taking four sacks. He completed 9 of 11 passes for 126 yards and a touchdown against four or fewer pass rushers, facing pressure on just 3 of 11 dropbacks (27.3%). Allen was most effective on quick passes, completing all 14 of his attempts with a time to throw under 2.5 seconds.

titulo: The Bills played single-high coverage on 10 of Carson Wentz's 26 dropbacks in Week 9 and finished with the same number of interceptions (1) on 10 pass attempts as completions allowed (1, for 2 yards).
detalle: They held Wentz to -1.41 EPA per dropback when playing single-high, the fourth-fewest by any passer since at least 2018 (min. 10 dropbacks). Buffalo's defense pressured Wentz on five of those 10 plays and 11 of his 26 dropbacks overall (42.3%) despite blitzing him just three times (11.5%).

titulo: Ed Oliver generated six pressures in the Bills' Week 9 win, his most in a game since the start of last season.
detalle: Oliver faced 12 double teams on 19 pass rushes (63.2%) and earned three pressures against double teams. Oliver became the tenth player this season and first Bills defender in over two seasons (DaQuan Jones, Week 7, 2024) to earn a pressure against a double team.

titulo: The Bills had five players run routes on eight of Josh Allen's 35 dropbacks (22.9%) in Week 9, less than half the rate of any other game in Joe Brady's career as their playcaller.
detalle: With five in the route, they gained 66 yards (8.3 per play) and scored their only passing touchdown, though Allen was pressured on four of eight plays (50.0%). Allen was pressured on 33.3% of plays with at least one extra blocker (9 of 27), but the Bills averaged 5.1 yards per play with fewer than five in the route.

titulo: Bryce Young completed 28 of 39 passes for 276 yards with three touchdowns and an interception in Week 9 against the Broncos.
detalle: Young went 13 of 14 for 152 yards and a touchdown on throws targeting in-breaking routes. Young has thrown for 1,127 yards on in-breaking routes this season, the most among all quarterbacks.

titulo: Caleb Williams was blitzed on 26 of 41 dropbacks (63.4%) in the Bears' Week 9 win, tied for the third-most blitzes any quarterback has faced in a game this season.
detalle: Williams was pressured on 13 of those 26 blitzes (50.0%) but was sacked just once. He started 7 of 10 for 124 yards and two touchdowns against the blitz, went 4 of 10 for 22 yards and three interceptions on his next nine drives, and completed 3 of 4 passes for 52 yards against the blitz on the Bears' game-winning drive.

titulo: Jaylon Johnson allowed just one reception for six yards on five targets in coverage in Week 9 and returned a third-quarter interception for a 67-yard touchdown.
detalle: Johnson's pick six increased the Bears' win probability from 66.3% to 91.1%. From Weeks 1-8, Johnson had allowed 12.2 yards per target, the second-most among cornerbacks targeted 20+ times. That number decreased to 10.8 following his performance tonight.

titulo: The Bears' defense generated seven pressures (41.2% pressure rate) and four sacks in the second half against the Buccaneers in Week 9, despite blitzing on just 2 of 17 dropbacks (11.8%).
detalle: That came after a first half with just four pressures (21.1% pressure rate) and no sacks. Across the full game, they blitzed on just 25.0% of dropbacks, marking their second consecutive game at or below that rate since adding Jeffery Simmons. Prior to his arrival, the Bears blitzed on 42.0% of dropbacks in Weeks 1-7, the fifth-highest rate in the NFL, compared to 22.7% across Weeks 8-9.

titulo: Joe Burrow completed 19 of 24 passes for 223 yards against single-high coverage in the Bengals' win over the Falcons, and his three touchdowns against single-high tied for the most by any quarterback in a game this season.
detalle: He went 12 of 13 for 172 yards and a touchdown against Cover 3, and 7 of 11 for 51 yards and two touchdowns against Cover 1. Burrow faced single-high on 81.3% of his dropbacks, the seventh-highest rate by a qualified passer in a game this season.

titulo: Ja'Marr Chase caught 10 of 12 targets for 155 yards and a touchdown against the Falcons.
detalle: He was matched up with A.J. Terrell on 13 routes (11 in man coverage), catching four of five targets for 103 yards and a touchdown. Seven of Chase's 10 catches came on underneath targets (under 10 air yards), but he also caught his lone deep target for a 47-yard touchdown, extending his NFL lead in deep touchdown receptions to five.

titulo: Joe Burrow was pressured on 9 of 32 dropbacks (28.1%) against the Falcons, completing 20 of 23 passes for 237 yards and two touchdowns when kept clean.
detalle: His time to pressure of 3.26 seconds was the longest of his career, and the Falcons defense had just one quick pressure in the game.

titulo: Shedeur Sanders completed 15 of his 19 attempts for 156 yards without pressure, his second-most in a game since entering the NFL.
detalle: Against pressure, Sanders completed 4 of his 12 attempts for 141 yards and two touchdowns, all in the second half and overtime -- he completed none of his attempts under pressure in the first half. The Saints generated pressure on 47.6% of dropbacks, a season-high mark, driven by Chase Young (9 pressures) and Carl Granderson (6 pressures), both posting season-high pressure totals.

titulo: Shedeur Sanders completed three of his six downfield attempts for 154 yards and a touchdown against the Saints, with all six attempts occurring in the second half and overtime.
detalle: Sanders' fourth-quarter deep pass to Jerry Jeudy set up a game-tying field-goal attempt that sent the game to overtime. Sanders added +55.5% win probability on downfield attempts, a career-high mark.

titulo: KC Concepcion and Denzel Boston combined for 183 of the Browns' 297 receiving yards against the Saints in Week 9, with most of that production driven by targets outside the numbers.
detalle: Concepcion caught three outside targets for a season-high 80 yards and a touchdown, while Boston hauled in a 60-yard deep reception, matching his longest of the season. Concepcion had one catch for 5 yards and Boston five receptions for 38 yards on all other targets.

titulo: Dak Prescott completed 8-of-11 passes against man coverage for a season-high 181 yards and two touchdowns in Week 9 against the Colts.
detalle: Prescott connected with CeeDee Lamb on four passes for 95 yards and a touchdown against man coverage, the fourth-most yards the duo has recorded against man in a single-game. Prescott completed 13-of-23 passes for 154 yards against zone coverage in the game.

titulo: CeeDee Lamb caught 6-of-12 targets for 180 yards and a touchdown on downfield throws (10+ air yards) in Week 9 against the Colts, the most receiving yards he has recorded on downfield throws in his career.
detalle: Lamb averaged 15.4 air yards per target, his second-highest mark of the season after recording a season-low 6.0 in Week 8 against the Cardinals. Lamb recorded downfield receptions against five different Colts defenders, with Sauce Gardner the only targeted defender to not allow a downfield reception against Lamb.

titulo: Bo Nix completed 25 of 37 passes for 237 yards with two touchdowns and an interception in Week 9 against the Panthers.
detalle: Nix posted a 124.2 passer rating against single-high coverage (20 of 26 for 202 yards and two touchdowns), but a 15.3 passer rating against split-safety coverage (5 of 11 for 35 yards and an interception). His 15.3 passer rating against split-safety looks was his lowest in a game since his NFL debut in Week 1, 2024.

titulo: Pat Surtain II allowed four catches on six targets for 36 yards and a touchdown in coverage against the Panthers.
detalle: Tetairoa McMillan caught three of his five targets with Surtain as his primary defender for 36 yards and a touchdown. It was the second touchdown that Surtain has allowed in coverage since the beginning of the 2025 season and the first since Week 13 of 2025.

titulo: After being pressured on 53.3% of his dropbacks in the first half (3 sacks), Jared Goff was pressured just 21.4% of the time in the second half, taking zero sacks.
detalle: Goff completed just two of his seven attempts for 18 yards against pressure across the entire game, including his one interception. When kept clean, Goff completed 15 of his 18 pass attempts for 152 yards.

titulo: Aidan Hutchinson matched up against Austin Jackson 16 times in Week 9 (all 1-on-1), recording 6 pressures (37.5% pressure rate), including two pressures under 2.5 seconds.
detalle: Hutchinson added a pressure against Patrick Paul (5 matchups) and Jonah Savaiinaea (2 matchups), with both of those also coming under 2.5 seconds. Hutchinson now leads the NFL in pressures (48) heading into the afternoon slate, and his 14 quick pressures are tied for 10th-most.

titulo: The Packers defense generated 11 unblocked pressures against the Patriots in Week 9, the 2nd-most by any defense in a game this season.
detalle: The Packers now lead the NFL with 43 unblocked pressures, eight more than any other defense. Twelve different Packers defenders generated a pressure, including all three of their safeties. Brenton Cox Jr. led the pass rush for the second consecutive game with five pressures, while backup linebacker Nick Niemann led the team with three unblocked pressures, after playing just two defensive snaps in Weeks 1-8.

titulo: Christian Gonzalez allowed a career-high ten receptions and 187 yards on 11 targets in coverage, nearly matching his yards allowed during his first six games this season (196 yards) and the third most by any defender in a game this season.
detalle: Gonzalez shadowed Matthew Golden when he was on the field, lining up across from him on 22 of 28 routes (78.6%). Gonzalez was targeted on seven of his 17 matchups against Golden, allowing all seven targets to be caught for 105 yards. He was also targeted on three of his four matchups against Christian Watson, allowing three receptions for 82 yards and a TD. Gonzalez is the only player since 2018 to allow more than 80 receiving yards to multiple players in the same game. He had never allowed more than 71 yards in a game to a single receiver previously.

titulo: Jordan Love completed 10 of his 12 downfield pass attempts (10+ air yards) for 294 yards and two touchdowns against the Patriots in Week 9, the third-most downfield passing yards by a quarterback this season.
detalle: Love averaged 24.5 yards per attempt on those downfield passes, the fifth-most in a single game since 2018. Six of his eight deep attempts (20+ air yards) were completions for 235 yards and one touchdown. Love now has two games with six deep completions this season, the only quarterback to do so. Christian Watson caught four of five deep targets for 143 yards, while Matthew Golden caught both of his deep targets for 92 yards, both career highs in yards.

titulo: C.J. Stroud completed 10-of-16 passes between 10 and 19 yards downfield for 254 yards, five touchdowns, and an interception in Week 9 against the Chargers.
detalle: It is the only game in which a quarterback has thrown five touchdowns targeting the intermediate level since at least 2016 and the third-most yards recorded by a quarterback on such throws in that span.

titulo: Danielle Hunter generated a season-high eight pressures and five quick pressures in Week 9 against the Chargers.
detalle: His eight pressures tie his single-game high since 2025, and his five quick pressures are the most he has recorded in that span. Hunter generated three quick pressures in seven matchups against Travis Burke and was the only Texans defender to record a pressure against Joe Alt, generating two across 16 matchups.

titulo: In the Texans' Week 9 win over the Chargers, Kamari Lassiter did not allow a reception on his five targets — the most targets he has faced in a game without allowing a reception — recording a career-high four passes defensed.
detalle: In his 10 man coverage snaps, Lassiter was targeted twice and recorded two passes defensed, only the second game in his career he has recorded multiple passes defensed while in man coverage.

titulo: Daniel Jones completed 17-of-23 passes for 144 yards and a touchdown on passes under 10 yards downfield in Week 9 against the Cowboys.
detalle: He averaged 2.6 air yards per completion in the game, third-fewest of his career (min. 10 completions). Jones completed 3-of-9 downfield passes for 36 yards, posting a 33.3% completion percentage on downfield throws — his lowest since 2024 (Week 6 vs. Cincinnati, 25.0%).

titulo: Adetomiwa Adebawore generated five pressures in Week 9 against the Cowboys, the second-most pressures he has recorded in a single game in his career.
detalle: Adebawore was double-teamed on 17-of-33 pass rushes (51.5%) and generated three pressures against double teams, tied for the second-most among defensive tackles in a game this season. Adebawore recorded four of his five pressures against Tyler Booker, tied for the second-most Booker has allowed in a single-game in his career.

titulo: Trevor Lawrence completed 8 of his 10 downfield attempts (10+ air yards) for 193 yards and a touchdown against the Ravens, his most downfield passing yards in a game and second-highest downfield completion rate (80.0%) of the season.
detalle: Lawrence went 8 of 16 for 49 yards on underneath pass attempts, recording a season-low 50.0% completion rate. Most of Lawrence's downfield production was spread across Jakobi Meyers (65 yards), Parker Washington (61 yards) and Nate Boerkircher (52 yards).

titulo: Trevor Lawrence completed 6-of-7 passes targeting in-breaking routes for 116 yards and a touchdown in Week 9 against the Ravens, recording a perfect 158.3 passer rating on such throws for the first time since 2023.
detalle: Lawrence connected with Parker Washington on a post route for a 50-yard touchdown in the second quarter, his second-longest touchdown pass on an in-breaking route this season.

titulo: Kenneth Walker carried the ball 18 times for 102 yards and one touchdown in a Week 9 win against the Jets.
detalle: Walker finished the game with a 61.1% rushing success rate, his highest rate of the season and the third highest rate of his career. Walker was stuffed on just one run today, his 5.6% run stuff rate is a season low. All four of his explosive runs came on six carries against neutral boxes (7 defenders in the box), recording 47 yards (7.8 yards per carry).

titulo: Chris Jones generated a season-high six pressures and two sacks on 29 pass rushes against the Jets in Week 9, including three quick pressures (under 2.5 seconds).
detalle: Two of those quick pressures came against Joe Tippmann, as Jones generated three pressures and his lone sack when matched up against him. The other quick pressure came against Armand Membou.

titulo: The Chiefs' defense generated a season-high 50.0% pressure rate against the Jets in Week 9, converting a season-high five of their 18 pressures into sacks (26.3%).
detalle: That came after they posted a league-low 9.8% pressure-to-sack rate in Weeks 1-8. When pressured, Geno Smith completed just six of 14 attempts for 59 yards.

titulo: Travis Kelce caught 4 of 6 targets for 72 yards in a Week 9 win against the Jets, accounting for 2 of the Chiefs' 5 explosive passes (40.0%).
detalle: Kelce had 56 of 72 receiving yards (77.8%) come after the catch, the fourth time this season he has surpassed the 75% YAC threshold.

titulo: The Rams used 13 personnel on 40 of 73 offensive plays (54.8%) in their win over the Commanders, the highest rate by an offense in a game this season.
detalle: In 13 personnel, the Rams averaged 5.3 yards per play with a 57.5% success rate and a touchdown. In all other groupings (33 plays), they averaged 4.4 yards per play with a 27.3% success rate and a touchdown.

titulo: Myles Garrett played 35 of 58 defensive snaps (60.3%) in his return from injury against the Commanders in Week 9, generating six pressures and three sacks on 27 pass rushes (22.2% pressure rate).
detalle: That's one more pressure than he had in the season opener against the 49ers. It was the first time this season that Garrett and Aaron Donald took the field together. With both on the field (23 plays), the Rams' defense allowed 5.0 yards per play and recorded four sacks. On all other plays (19), the defense allowed 8.0 yards per play and a touchdown with no sacks.

titulo: Puka Nacua recorded a season-high 150 receiving yards in the Rams' win over the Commanders in Week 9, and his 3.5 yards per route run were his second-most in a game this season.
detalle: Washington played zone on 84.1% of his routes, and Nacua caught 12 of 17 targets for 128 yards against it, his most yards against zone coverage in a game this season. He added two receptions for 22 yards and a touchdown against man coverage.

titulo: Justin Herbert completed 2-of-11 downfield passes (10+ air yards) for 66 yards and an interception in Week 9 against the Texans, the fewest yards he has recorded on such throws in a game this season.
detalle: His 18.2% completion percentage on downfield passes is the second-lowest of his career. He has now thrown an interception on a downfield pass in every game this season.

titulo: Brock Bowers caught 7 of his 8 targets for 111 yards and a touchdown in a loss to the 49ers.
detalle: Bowers was the only Raiders' pass catcher to record a reception against man coverage (2 receptions, 29 yards). Half of Bowers' targets (4 of 8) came between 10 and 19 yards from the line of scrimmage, catching all four for 91 yards and a touchdown. Bowers was the only Raiders pass catcher to surpass 60 receiving yards on the day, recording 46 yards after the catch — more than the 42 yards after the catch from all other Raiders pass catchers combined.

titulo: Caleb Douglas was targeted on all four of his out routes in Week 9 against the Lions, catching three of them for 38 yards.
detalle: Douglas caught an additional pass for 12 yards outside the numbers, with his remaining three targets, two receptions, and 20 yards coming between the numbers. Douglas now has 128 yards on out routes (7th-most entering afternoon slate).

titulo: Andrew Van Ginkel pressured Josh Allen five times in the Vikings' Week 9 loss to the Bills, tied for his most in a game this season.
detalle: Van Ginkel paired that with four quarterback hits, tied for his most ever in a game. Van Ginkel was one of four Vikings defenders to earn a pressure against Tylan Grable who replaced the injured Dion Dawkins at left tackle.

titulo: Drake Maye was pressured on 51.2% of his dropbacks against the Packers, the highest pressure rate he has faced in a regular-season game, just below the 52.8% he faced in the Super Bowl against the Seahawks.
detalle: Maye completed 9 of 18 attempts (50.0%) for 122 yards and a touchdown under pressure, his second-most yards under pressure. He threw all three of his interceptions when he was kept clean, his second game doing so this season. Michael Penix is the only other player to throw three interceptions without pressure in a game this season. The Packers' pressure rate nearly doubled from the first half (36.0%) to the second half (71.4%), with the Packers recording 13 pressures and three sacks in the second half.

titulo: Tyler Shough completed all three of his downfield attempts in the first half for 99 yards.
detalle: He doubled his downfield attempts to six in the second half and added two more in overtime, completing two of those eight for 48 yards and a touchdown to clinch the Saints' overtime win. Shough also recorded 51 rushing yards on 10 rushes, including five scrambles for a career-high 41 yards.

titulo: The Giants' starting outside cornerbacks combined to allow just four receptions for 31 yards on 11 combined targets against the Eagles.
detalle: Greg Newsome II recorded a pass defensed and forced tight windows on three of his five targets. Deonte Banks allowed just one reception on six targets.

titulo: Arvell Reese earned three sacks in Week 9, including two when blitzing from an inside linebacker alignment, the only player in the NFL this season with two or more sacks aligned at ILB in a game.
detalle: Reese's first sack, rushing from the edge, was the fastest by any player this season (2.29 seconds) and forced a fumble that the Giants recovered. Reese recorded 12 tackles on the day, 11 of which were stops that forced unsuccessful plays, and missed just one tackle.

titulo: David Bailey generated six pressures on 24 pass rushes in Week 9 against the Chiefs, while recording two strip-sacks, one of which the Jets recovered.
detalle: All six of those pressures came in the first half, and five of them, including two sacks, came against Chiefs right tackle Jaylon Moore.

titulo: Jonathan Greenard generated five pressures and a sack on 20 pass rushes in Week 9, nearly matching his season total to date.
detalle: Greenard had earned just six pressures on 67 pass rushes in his first five games played this season. Greenard played a majority of the Eagles' defensive snaps for the first time this season (35 snaps, 54.7%).

titulo: Quinyon Mitchell played shadow coverage for the first time in a game this season in Week 9 against the Giants, aligning across from Malik Nabers for 24 of 30 snaps (80.0%).
detalle: Previously this season, Quinyon Mitchell had primarily aligned as the right outside cornerback (Weeks 1-6) and as the boundary cornerback (Weeks 7-8). Across 18 matchups against Mitchell in coverage, Nabers caught just two of three targets for 7 yards. Against all other defenders, Nabers caught three of five targets for 36 yards.

titulo: Drew Lock averaged a 2.41-second time to throw in the Seahawks' Week 9 win, the quickest of his career.
detalle: Lock completed 13 of 18 quick passes (under 2.5 seconds) for 110 yards and a touchdown. Lock completed just 7 of 12 passes for 44 yards to receivers aligned out wide but finished 12-for-16 for 131 yards and his lone touchdown pass when targeting other alignments, connecting with Jadarian Price out of the backfield four times for 54 yards.

titulo: Brock Purdy completed 17 of his 25 pass attempts for two touchdowns in a Week 9 win against the Raiders, completing 7 of his 11 pass attempts for 153 yards and one touchdown on passes that traveled at least 10 air yards.
detalle: Purdy's 44.0% downfield throw rate is his second highest rate of the season (Wk 2 vs Dolphins, 45.5%), and with only 31.0% of his passing yards coming after the catch, this marks his second lowest rate of the season (Wk 3 vs Cardinals, 29.6%). On the ground that he recorded a season-high 4 scramble attempts for 36 yards and one touchdown.

titulo: Jordan Watkins caught all four of his receiving targets for 84 yards (career-high) and his first career touchdown in a win against the Raiders; his 17.4 average air yards per target were a season high.
detalle: Despite finishing tied for second in target share on the day (17.4%), Watkins led the team in receiving yards and finished with +40 receiving yards over expected; no other 49ers finished with more than +11 (Brandin Cooks). He also led the team with 3.3 yards per route run (minimum 5 routes).

titulo: Trent Williams allowed just two pressures on 30 pass blocks (6.7%) in a Week 9 win against the Raiders, however, for just the second time this season he allowed a sack.
detalle: Against Williams, Malcolm Koonce earned a pressure while Maxx Crosby earned the only sack allowed by a 49ers offensive lineman today.

titulo: Bucky Irving rushed for 97 yards and two touchdowns on 20 carries against the Bears in Week 9.
detalle: Half of those carries came to the left side of the formation, where he gained 57 yards and scored both touchdowns. Irving has totaled a league-high 505 rushing yards on carries to the left entering Monday Night Football. He added four receptions on five targets for 28 yards in the passing game.

titulo: The Buccaneers played Cover 3 on 63.4% of the Bears' dropbacks in Week 9, recording four interceptions and their only sack in Cover 3 while holding Caleb Williams to 6.0 yards per attempt.
detalle: They recorded four INTs in Cover 3 for the second consecutive week – only two other defenses have intercepted 4+ passes in Cover 3 in any game since 2018. Tampa Bay has allowed just one touchdown in Cover 3 this season while recording 12 interceptions, seven more than any other defense.
